findings.body: The terminal and Desktop cases remain outside automated testing: `forge.toml:6` and `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58` execute only Python tests. The reported native run verifies this revision, but subsequent changes could break the button-free fallback without failing those checks. `plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284` assigns the native plugin test job to SHIP; that task should include this file. This previously reported gap remains open.
findings.title: Later: SHIP must include the approval tests in the native test job
